channel.title: FierceBiotech — Health, Longevity & Diet
channel.description: FierceBiotech articles filtered for longevity, health, diet, and healthspan research

item.title: Teva autoimmune antibody notches ph. 2 win in celiac disease
item.description: Teva Pharmaceutical's dreams of a first-in-class autoimmune blockbuster are being kept alive after the Israeli outfit’s anti-interleukin-15 antibody scored a midstage win in celiac disease.

item.title: TScan axes 75% of workforce to make room for solid tumor programs
item.description: TCR-T specialist TScan Therapeutics will reduce its workforce by 75% following the pause of its hematological and autoimmune programs.

item.title: From his parents’ basement to your medicine cabinet: Absci CEO endeavors to create biotech’s Apple
item.description: The overwhelming demand for GLP-1 weight loss drugs has reshaped the drug market, empowering consumers to take charge of their own health and removing barriers between their wallets and their medicine cabinets.

item.title: Alumis crushed by midstage lupus flop but plots path to phase 3 for TYK2 inhibitor
item.description: A phase 2b lupus trial of Alumis’ envudeucitinib has missed its primary and secondary endpoints. But the biotech is still moving the TYK2 inhibitor into phase 3 in the autoimmune disease, pointing to evidence of efficacy in a prespecified subgroup of patients to support its decision.

item.title: GSK catches phase 3 fever after mRNA flu vaccine beats standard shots
item.description: GSK has linked its mRNA seasonal flu vaccine candidate to higher immune responses than conventional jabs in a phase 2 trial, emboldening the company to start a pivotal study this month.

item.title: UPDATED: Novartis halts autoimmune CAR-T trials after 3 deaths, as BMS also pauses studies
item.description: Three deaths have forced Novartis to pause development of its CD19 CAR-T candidate in autoimmune diseases, just as Bristol Myers Squibb has halted a similar program due to immune-related adverse events, Fierce has learned.

item.title: ESC26: AstraZeneca's heart failure drug shows promise in ph. 2 trial
item.description: AstraZeneca’s oral relaxin agonist delivered encouraging phase 2b results in chronic heart failure, improving measures of cardiac function across two patient groups.

item.title: Eli Lilly inks $2.88B Merida buyout for autoimmune drugs against rogue antibodies
item.description: Eli Lilly has struck a deal to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion, establishing a beachhead in efforts to treat disease through the selective degradation of pathogenic autoantibodies.
